ParentAccount.title: ParentAccount
ParentAccount.description: Parent account profile, unique LM-XXXXX identifier, recovery email, and salted PIN verifier for Lock Monitor.

parentUid.description: Authenticated Google user UID of the parent.

recoveryEmail.description: Recovery email for PIN reset verification.

pinHash.description: Salted SHA-256 hash verifier of the parent app-access PIN.

pinSalt.description: Random cryptographic salt used for the PIN verifier.

connectedStudentIds.description: Bounded list of connected Student IDs (SL-XXXXX).

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when account was created (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when account was last updated (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

StudentProfile.title: StudentProfile
StudentProfile.description: Student device registration, pairing state, authorized schedules, approved apps, and real-time telemetry.

studentId.description: Unique Student ID (e.g., SL-A7K92) generated per installation.

studentUid.description: Authenticated Google user UID of the student device.

deviceRegistrationId.description: Installation-specific registration ID to detect reinstalls/phone replacements.

pairedParentUid.description: UID of the parent after student approves pairing (empty string when unpaired).

pairedParentId.description: Parent ID (LM-XXXXX) of the paired parent.

pendingParentUid.description: UID of a parent requesting connection prior to student approval.

pendingParentName.description: Name of the parent requesting connection.

safeLockStatus.description: Confirmed SafeLock enforcement state on the student device.

approvedApps.description: Parent-authorized package names allowed during restricted mode.

proposedApps.description: Student-proposed package names awaiting parent approval.

authorizedScheduleSlots.description: Parent-authorized schedule slots formatted as DAY|START|END|LABEL.

proposedScheduleSlots.description: Student-proposed schedule slots awaiting parent approval.

emergencyUnlockUntilMillis.description: Epoch milliseconds when active emergency unlock expires (0 if inactive).

lastCommandId.description: ID of the last remote command processed by the student device.

lastCommandStatus.description: Execution confirmation status of the last command.

StudentRequest.title: StudentRequest
StudentRequest.description: Student-initiated request for app permission, schedule change, or emergency unlock.

studentUid.description: Authenticated Google UID of the student.

parentUid.description: Authenticated Google UID of the paired parent.

payloadValue.description: Structured value (package name, schedule slot, or requested duration).

status.description: Current approval status of the request.

approvedDurationMinutes.description: Duration in minutes selected by parent when approving an emergency unlock.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of last status change (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

DeviceCommand.title: DeviceCommand
DeviceCommand.description: Authorized remote Lock/Unlock/Emergency Unlock command sent from Lock Monitor to SafeLock.

commandId.description: Unique command identifier to prevent replay or duplicate execution.

durationMinutes.description: Optional duration in minutes (0 for immediate lock/unlock).

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when command was issued (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when command was confirmed (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

/parents/{parentUid}.description: Parent account documents keyed by authenticated parent UID.

/students/{studentId}.description: Student device profiles keyed by unique generated Student ID (SL-XXXXX).

/student_requests/{requestId}.description: Requests submitted by students to their paired parent.

/device_commands/{commandId}.description: Remote lock/unlock commands issued by parents and confirmed by student devices.
